name: plugin_ops
description: Start, stop, or restart an installed plugin's service. Only call this after the customer has explicitly agreed to the action -- never speculatively, since stopping/restarting interrupts the plugin while it's down. This is the only way to start/stop/restart a plugin's service -- do not use run_diagnostic_step/services_ops for plugins, that's for core services (isy, udx, etc.) only. This tool has no status operation -- to check a plugin's current status, read the `state` field from list_installed_plugins instead.

operation.description: The operation to perform on the plugin's service.
